My understanding is that the original injury is what caused the tear, so I wasn’t sure whether an incident report was needed. I wanted to check in with you to make sure I’m taking care of everything I should be.

Additionally, he’ll need to submit paperwork for a reasonable accommodation to work from home for a few weeks after the surgery. I’ll work with him on that to get it submitted.

How to compute sample size using G*Power for the following study?
The study will be conducted using a 1x3 between-subjects design (n=120) with the independent variable “Visualization Type” with the levels VR, 2D, and None. The study participants will hence be divided into three groups and undergo either of the three levels. They will be asked to fill out questionnaires at the beginning and the end of the study, which will record their personality traits, psychological well-being, and self-reported public speaking anxiety. 

During the study, the participants will give two speeches and will be asked to fill out pre- and post-speech questionnaires regarding their public speaking anxiety level and perceived performance. We will record their physiological data throughout the study. Additionally, we will record their speeches to extract speech metrics and record their speech videos to extract their non-verbal behaviors like hand, head, and body movement. At the end of the study, we will conduct a short interview to gather subjective feedback from the participants about their experience of the respective condition.

Meta question. How to write a good prompt for a specific task? Example: I'd like to refine my understanding of multiple space missions and constellation proposals, would the following prompt be good for this purpose? That's a generic prompt, I intend to follow it with specific mission/constellation details.

You are a seasoned aerospace engineer with deep expertise in orbital mechanics, space hardware, and mission design. You combine passion for space innovation with a grounded, practical understanding of engineering constraints, cost, and physics. You excel at identifying technical challenges and proposing realistic solutions, backed by quick back-of-the-envelope calculations to verify feasibility. You communicate complex concepts clearly and concisely to audiences with some technical background. You can select right level of abstraction for your analysis and reevaluate your assumptions if necessary.
Style: Maintain a clear, concise, and objective tone. Clearly state assumptions that you make. If the presented task is complex, start with drafting a short actionable plan to address it. Prefer breadth-first approach: examine high-level system or mission viability before going into details.

i need to create around 5-10 posts for promoting my plant themed board game campaign - I will upload these posts on facebook and instagram and an image + text. Remember they shouldnt be too long (few sentences at most) since people attention is not big, so they should get hooked with first sentences about the idea that I'm presenting and the rest of the text should quickly explain it further. The topics for each post would be:

3) Using metal net on the angle for growing cucumbers, which makes them spread a lot and it supports hanging fruits which can weight a lot later on

4) using white insect net to cover your crops (diffrent kinds of plants) which still gives plants sun but at the same time gives you protection from most things

6) picking up your varieties so that you can test which ones are working best in your specific area, thanks to that you will have a result that variety x is best since no pests/diseases touch it and it yields better than planting random ones or the ones that someone from diffrent country have reccomended

7) plants that protect from mosquitos (make them fly away from your garden) which are I think basil, peppermint, oregano and others

8) usuing woodchips in your garden as a trails between your garden beds and places where you plant which makes it much easier to get rid of weeds and also they make soil not that hot + also you could use them as a form of layer to plant your plants if you have very bad soil in your area where nothing wants to grow
